# TagInput

TagInput — a field of Tags with a text entry after them, modeled on Notion's multi-select. Focusing the field opens a list of the options. Typing filters it and highlights the first match; Enter or a click adds the highlighted option. A "Create *text*" row is offered when no option matches the text exactly, ignoring case. It previews the new tag as the Tag it will be, in the random Tag color it will get, and creating reports that color once through `onCreate`. Backspace in an empty entry removes the last tag, and Esc closes the list and clears only the typed text. People can tidy the options where they pick them, as in Notion. With `onRename`, `onDelete` or `onColorChange`, the highlighted row shows a "…" that opens the option's menu: its name, Delete, and Tag's ten colors. With `onReorder`, each row has a handle to drag, or to pick up with Space and move with the arrows. Without these handlers neither appears. Built on the shared parts: `_Field` is the box, `Listbox` the list and its rows, and the chips are Tags in a TagGroup. Without focus the tags collapse into "+n"; with focus they wrap, up to three rows, then scroll.

## Usage

Use `TagInput` when a field's value is a set of short labels the person picks
from a list and may add to: the topics a session covered, or the languages a
tutor teaches. It behaves like Notion's multi-select. The field holds the
picked values as `Tag`s in a `TagGroup`, with a text entry after them, and
focusing it opens the list of options under it.

- For one value from a list, use `Select`.
- For several values from a fixed list nobody adds to, use `Select` with `isMulti`.
- For fewer than 5 options, use a Checkbox group (`Fieldset` + `Checkbox`).

## Best practices

### Label every tag input. {#label-every-tag-input}

A visible label says what the tags are; tags alone do not.

Do: A label names what is being tagged.
Don't: Tags with no label leave the field unnamed.

### Show an error on the field itself. {#show-an-error-on-the-field-itself}

The field carries the error state.

Do: The field shows the error state.
Don't: A default field gives no sign of the problem.

### Disable instead of hiding. {#disable-instead-of-hiding}

A disabled field tells people the option exists but is unavailable.

Do: Visible but disabled.
Don't: An enabled field that cannot take tags.

### The caller owns the options, and stores what is created. {#the-caller-owns-the-options-and-stores-what-is-created}

`options` is required. When the person creates a value, `onCreate` reports it
once, with the color it was given. Store both on a new option, so the color
stays the same everywhere the tag appears.

```jsx
// Incorrect — the created value is never stored, so its color is lost on the next render.
<TagInput label="Topics" options={topics} />

// Correct — the new value joins the options with its color.
<TagInput
    label="Topics"
    options={topics}
    onCreate={({ value, color }) => setTopics((list) => [...list, { value, label: value, color }])}
/>
```

### A value saved to a server holds a temporary id until it is confirmed. {#a-value-saved-to-a-server-holds-a-temporary-id-until-it-is-confirmed}

Return a promise from `onCreate` that resolves to the stored id. Until it
does, the tag is saving and its `value` is a temporary id starting `new-`. If
it rejects, the tag is removed, the text goes back in the entry, and the
failure is announced.

```jsx
<TagInput
    label="Topics"
    options={topics}
    onCreate={({ value, color }) => api.createTopic({ name: value, color }).then((topic) => topic.id)}
/>
```

### A controlled field needs a handler to offer a ×. {#a-controlled-field-needs-a-handler-to-offer-a}

```jsx
// Incorrect — controlled with no handler, so no tag can be removed and none shows a ×.
<TagInput label="Topics" options={topics} tags={picked} />

// Correct — onChange receives the new list.
<TagInput label="Topics" options={topics} tags={picked} onChange={setPicked} />
```

### Let people tidy options where they pick them. {#let-people-tidy-options-where-they-pick-them}

Pass a handler for each change the screen can store. The caller owns the
options, so each handler updates the list. TagInput only reports the change.
A field with none of them works as before, with no "…" and no handle.

```jsx
<TagInput
    label="Topics"
    options={topics}
    onRename={(value, name) => setTopics((list) => list.map((t) => (t.value === value ? { ...t, label: name } : t)))}
    onDelete={(value) => setTopics((list) => list.filter((t) => t.value !== value))}
    onColorChange={(value, color) => setTopics((list) => list.map((t) => (t.value === value ? { ...t, color } : t)))}
    onReorder={(from, to) => setTopics((list) => {
        const next = [...list];
        next.splice(to, 0, ...next.splice(from, 1));
        return next;
    })}
/>
```

- **Delete** also removes a picked tag made from that option, through
  `onChange` and `onRemove`. Rename and a color change update that tag too.
- **Reorder** works on the whole list, so the handles hide while text is
  typed. `onReorder(fromIndex, toIndex)` gives places in `options`.

### A tag's color is a Tag color. {#a-tag-s-color-is-a-tag-color}

A tag is a category, so it takes a Tag color. Any other name draws gray and
warns in development.

### The keys behave as in Notion. {#the-keys-behave-as-in-notion}

| Key | In the field |
| --- | --- |
| Typing | Filters the list and highlights the first match. |
| ↑ ↓ | Move the highlight; opens the list when it is closed. |
| Enter | Adds the highlighted option, or creates the typed text when Create is highlighted. Text matching an option, ignoring case, picks that option. |
| Backspace | In an empty entry, removes the last tag. |
| Esc | Closes the list and clears only the typed text. The tags stay. |
| Paste | Text with commas or line breaks becomes one tag per part, trimmed. |
| Tab | With a handler for the menu or reordering, moves from the entry to the highlighted row's handle, then its "…". |

On a row's handle and in its menu:

| Key | Does |
| --- | --- |
| Space or Enter on the handle | Picks the row up. |
| ↑ ↓ | Move the picked-up row. |
| Space or Enter | Drops it there. |
| Esc | Cancels, and the row goes back. |
| Enter on the "…" | Opens the menu with focus in the name. |
| Enter in the name | Renames the option. After ↑ ↓, picks the highlighted row instead. |
| Esc in the menu | Closes it without renaming, and focus goes back to the "…". |

## Accessibility

- **The label names the entry.** The text entry is a `combobox` that points at
  the list with `aria-controls` and at the highlighted row with
  `aria-activedescendant`, so focus stays in the field while the arrow keys
  move through the list.
- **The tags are a named list.** `TagGroup` is a list named "Selected:" and the
  label, and each × is named `Remove <tag>`.
- **Changes are announced.** Adding or removing a tag says so in a live
  region, such as "Music added".
- **Invalid is announced.** The message under the field has `role="alert"`,
  and the entry has `aria-invalid` and is described by it.
- **Read-only and disabled leave nothing to press.** Neither draws a × or opens
  the list.
- **A row's handle and "…" are real buttons.** They sit beside the listbox,
  laid over the highlighted row, because an option's content is presentational
  and a button inside one would be lost to a screen reader. They are named `Reorder <option>` and
  `Options for <option>`, and the handle is described by its keys.
- **Reordering is announced.** Picking up, each move, the drop and a cancel
  each say the row and its position, such as "Design judgment dropped,
  position 3 of 4".
- **The menu takes focus and gives it back.** Opening it moves focus to the
  name field. Closing it returns focus to the "…".

- For one value rather than a set, use `Tag`.
- For the set without a field around it, use `TagGroup`.
- For several values from a fixed list, use `Select` with `isMulti`.

## Parts

1. **Field.** The box holding the tags and the text entry.
2. **Tags.** The picked values, each removable unless the field is read-only or disabled.
3. **Entry.** The text entry after the tags. Typing filters the list.
4. **List.** The options under the field, with a "Create" row when nothing matches.
5. **Caption.** Helper text, or the error that replaces it.

### States

| State | What changes |
| --- | --- |
| Rest | The input fill with a `--border-default` input edge. Tags past one line collapse into "+n". |
| Hovered | The edge turns `--ds-border-focused`. |
| Pressed | No step of its own. The hovered edge holds while the pointer is down. |
| Focused | A `--focus-ring-width` ring in `--ds-border-focused`, `--focus-ring-width` off the box; the tags wrap and the list opens. |
| Disabled | The whole field fades to `--ds-opacity-disabled`; every tag is disabled, with no × and no entry. |
| Invalid | The edge takes `--ds-border-danger` and the message `--ds-text-danger`. |
| Read-only | The `--ds-background-neutral` fill, with no × and no list. |

### Tokens

| Part | Token |
| --- | --- |
| Box | `--ds-background-input` fill, `--border-default` edge in `--ds-border-input`. |
| Height | Starts at 40: `--height-250`. Compact 32: `--item-height-md`. Grows as tags wrap. |
| Radius | 10: `--radius-0625`. Compact 8: `--radius-h32`. |
| Tags and entry | `--stack-md` between them; with focus, up to three rows of tags before the content scrolls. |
| Entry text | `--body-default` in `--ds-text`; placeholder `--ds-text-subtlest`. |
| List | `--ds-surface-overlay` with a `--ds-border` edge, `--popover-radius-menu-md` and `--ds-shadow-overlay`. |
| List hint | `--body-small` in `--ds-text-subtle`, `--space-025` `--pad-x-md`. |
| Row handle | `--ds-icon-subtle`. |
| Option menu | `--option-menu-width` wide; the name field `--space-025` `--pad-x-sm`; a `--border-default` rule in `--ds-border` above the colors. |

The tags take Tag's own tokens.

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Write each tag as a short noun phrase: "Fractions". | A sentence as a tag. |
| Reuse existing tags before creating a new one. | Near-duplicates: "Fraction" and "Fractions". |
| Say what to do in an error: "Pick at least one topic". | "Required" or "Invalid". |
| Keep tags to a few words. | A tag that wraps. |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `id` | string | — | — |
| `name` | string | — | — |
| `label` | node | — | Names the field. Give every TagInput one. |
| `required` | bool | `false` | Shows an asterisk and sets `aria-required`. |
| `info` | node | — | Text for an info tooltip beside the label. |
| `caption` | node | — | Standing help under the field. A validation message takes its place. |
| `placeholder` | string | `'Select or create a tag'` | Shown in the entry while there are no tags. |
| `options` | arrayOf (required) | `[]` | The options the list offers: strings, or objects with `value`, `label` (or `text`) and a Tag `color`. Required; the caller owns the list and adds what `onCreate` reports to it. |
| `tags` | arrayOf | — | The picked tags, controlled. Pass `onChange` with it. |
| `defaultTags` | arrayOf | `[]` | The picked tags at first, uncontrolled. |
| `spacing` | enum | `'default'` | `default` draws a 40 field and `compact` a 32 one. |
| `disabled` | bool | `false` | Disables every tag and the entry. |
| `readOnly` | bool | `false` | Shows the tags with no × and no entry, on the read-only fill. |
| `isInvalid` | bool | `false` | — |
| `errorMessage` | node | — | Shown under the field, and announced, while `isInvalid` is set. |
| `maxLength` | number | — | The longest a new value can be. |
| `maxTags` | number | — | The most tags the field holds. At the limit, Create hides and the list says so. |
| `onAdd` | func | — | `(tag)`: a tag was added, picked or created. |
| `onCreate` | func | — | `({ value, color })`: a new value was created, with the color it was given. Store both on the option. Return a promise of the stored id to hold the tag on a temporary id, saving, until it resolves; a rejection removes the tag and puts the text back. |
| `onRemove` | func | — | `(index, tag)`: a tag was removed. |
| `onChange` | func | — | `(tags)`: the new list, after any add or remove. |
| `onRename` | func | — | `(value, name)`: an option was renamed from its "…" menu. Store the new name on the option. A picked tag made from it takes the name too. |
| `onDelete` | func | — | `(value)`: an option was deleted from its "…" menu. Remove it from `options`; a picked tag made from it is removed with it. |
| `onColorChange` | func | — | `(value, color)`: an option was given another of Tag's ten colors from its "…" menu. Store it on the option. |
| `onReorder` | func | — | `(fromIndex, toIndex)`: an option was moved by its handle, by drag or by the keyboard. Both are places in `options`; move the option there. |
| `className` | string | `''` | — |
| `style` | object | — | — |
